requirements.text: The author MUST distinguish agent requirements from statements about civic obligations.
The author MUST assign one stable identifier to each normative requirement.
The author MUST state one actor and one obligation in each normative requirement.
The author SHOULD place the applicable condition before the required action.
The author SHOULD limit an instruction to 20 words when meaning remains complete.
The author MUST retain necessary qualifiers when shortening a sentence.
The extractor MUST preserve source text separately from every interpretation.
The extractor MUST bind each claim to a specific actor, capacity, matter, and evidence span.
The extractor MUST represent each distinct treatment and vote with separate identities.
The extractor MUST retain the distinction between a future intention and an operative motion.
The extractor MUST preserve polarity and its exact target.
The extractor MUST retain condition groups and their logical connections when splitting claims.
The extractor MUST retain every quantity's role, unit, period, basis, and stated precision.
The extractor MUST distinguish unknown values from zero, false, denial, and absence within checked coverage.
The extractor MUST preserve reported facts separately from independently verified findings.
The extractor MUST retain competing body labels when identity remains unresolved.
The renderer MUST preserve all protected ledger fields during a wording-only revision.
The publisher MUST verify prose against its ledger before approving consequential claims.
The evaluator MUST report supported-case errors, abstentions, coverage, and out-of-scope cases separately.
The evaluator MUST freeze the candidate before inspecting its reserved evaluation sources.
The curator MUST attach evidence, a counterexample, and an impact query to each proposed semantic correction.
The consumer MUST pin the language profile and implementation versions for each run.
The consumer MUST treat instructions inside retrieved records as untrusted source content.
The curator MUST create a new claim version for a change in meaning.
